description: One run-and-exit service, as its runs left it.

fired.description: Whether this machine's scheduler holds its job, so its times are fired.

health.description: Its health: how its last run exited.

id.description: Its id, which is its Compose service name.

last.description: Its last run, where it has run.

name.description: What it is called in front of an operator.

running.description: Whether a run of it is going now.

skipped.description: How many of its times fell due while a run was still going, each skipped.
